name: Studying
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of diligent study and meditation on God's Word as a means to live obediently and prosperously, as seen in Joshua 1:8 and Deuteronomy 28:13. The example of Ezra in Ezra 7:10 highlights the preparation of the heart to seek, do, and teach God's statutes, demonstrating that studying Scripture is both a personal and communal responsibility. The Word of God provides guidance and illumination for life’s path, described in Psalms 119:105 as a lamp to one’s feet. While Ecclesiastes 12:12 warns of the weariness that can come from excessive study apart from God’s truth, Daniel 1:17 shows that God grants understanding and wisdom to those who seek Him, affirming that true knowledge and skill come from divine enablement.
